added.summary: rune-kit's keyboard model (MIT, third_party/rune-kit): inside a focus group Home and End go to its first and last member and PageUp and PageDown as far as one view reaches; in a group whose role is a list's (listbox, menu, list, tree, tablist) letters typed under a second apart pick the first member whose name starts with them, and the same letter again cycles. A dropdown's options are one wrapping group, and Up or Down on its closed trigger opens it. The UI state is version 17 (the typed letters); og.ui saves migrate 16 to 17.
